captions.text: Doubling a musical frequency produces an octave.
Perceived loudness also depends on frequency and listening conditions,
so amplitude is not a universal loudness scale.
Compare 220 and 440 Hz at the same low amplitude.
Then keep 440 Hz and vary amplitude gently;
Which adjustment raises a 220 Hz note by one octave?
Which adjustment raises a 220 Hz note by one octave?
Choose an answer using the model or program you just tested.
The feedback will explain the difference between the alternatives.
